name: Sticky Grid Scroll
description: Full-screen intro image followed by a sticky section where a title sits over an image grid. Scrolling slides columns in, then zooms and spreads the grid apart while a description and link appear.
contents: Sticky section with title, description and link
Square image grid with configurable columns
behavior: Sticky section slides up over the intro with a parallax effect
Grid columns enter from alternating top and bottom with stagger, scrubbed by scroll
Grid zooms while outer columns shift sideways and middle columns shift vertically
Description and link fade in as the zoom completes and fade out when scrolling back
Smooth scrolling through Lenis, with a line loader until images are preloaded

props.name: description
props.default: A structured scroll-driven image grid where movement unfolds progressively within a sticky layout.

editableByProps: All text, link, intro image and grid images
Column count, grid width, gaps, zoom and shift amounts, stagger
Scroll length, intro height, smooth scroll on or off and its feel

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which columns enter from the top versus the bottom
Change the timing between reveal, zoom and content toggle

needsCodeEdit.where: isLoading block at the top of the returned JSX and the loader keyframes in the style tag

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis unless enableSmoothScroll is false, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Registers a gsap ticker and ScrollTrigger instances, all removed on unmount
Title font defaults to Fraunces but the font is not loaded by the component, the host page must provide it or it falls back to serif
Shows a fixed full-screen loader overlay until images are preloaded
Includes the intro section and a tall scroll section that the effect needs for its scroll range
